Class ChangefeedBuilder

java.lang.Object
com.cockroachlabs.crdb.cdc.ChangefeedBuilder
public final class ChangefeedBuilder extends Object
Fluent builder for a CockroachDB CREATE CHANGEFEED statement.

Produces SQL of the form: 

CREATE CHANGEFEED FOR TABLE <tables> INTO '<sink>' WITH <k = 'v'>, <flag>, ...

Example: 

String sql = ChangefeedBuilder.forTables("orders", "payments")
        .intoWebhook("https://sink.example/cdc")
        .format("json")
        .updated()
        .diff()
        .resolved("10s")
        .toSql();

Table identifiers are validated to guard against injection; option values are single-quote escaped. WITH options preserve insertion order so generated SQL is deterministic.
